items.quote: the LORD hath called by name Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah
items.claim: The LORD called Bezaleel by name, identified as son of Uri and Hur from the tribe of Judah

items.quote: he hath filled him with the spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all manner of workmanship
items.claim: Bezaleel was filled with the spirit of God and given wisdom, understanding, knowledge, and workmanship ability

items.quote: And to devise curious works, to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass
items.claim: Bezaleel was capable of devising intricate works and working in gold, silver, and brass
items.action: to devise curious works, to work

items.quote: And in the cutting of stones, to set them, and in carving of wood, to make any manner of cunning work
items.claim: Bezaleel was skilled in cutting stones, setting them, and carving wood for intricate works
